result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed. The main defect is the promo banner, whose white text on a pale mint background is nearly unreadable. There is also a minor overlap problem on the first 'Fastest near you' card.

issues.description: The promo banner text ('3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') is white on a very light mint background. Contrast is extremely low, so the headline and the promo code are barely legible.
issues.suggestion: Use a dark text color, or a darker or more saturated banner background, to reach at least 4.5:1 contrast (3:1 for the large headline). Make sure the promo code stands out.

issues.description: On the first 'Fastest near you' card (Green Bowl Poké), the '15–25 min' pill overlaps the edge of the bowl illustration. The image is also washed out against its light gray background, so the card looks low-contrast and inconsistent next to the darker cards.
issues.suggestion: Reposition the time pill so it doesn't collide with the image subject. Use a background or image treatment consistent with the other cards.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on the pizza card sits on a semi-transparent dark circle that blends into the dark wood background. The white '−20%' badge is also low-emphasis, so both controls look inconsistent and have weak affordance.
issues.suggestion: Give the favorite button a consistent, more opaque background, and style the discount badge to stand out.
